# Generated by tools/build_seals.py.

# Character scope: a d6 pool; each 5-6 is a success, and sixes explode.
ac_seal_dice_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = $OUT$ value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = ac_seal_dice_left value = $DICE$ }
	while = {
		limit = { var:ac_seal_dice_left > 0 }
		random_list = {
			4 = { }
			1 = { change_variable = { name = $OUT$ add = 1 } }
			1 = { change_variable = { name = $OUT$ add = 1 } random = { chance = 33 change_variable = { name = $OUT$ add = 1 } } }
		}
		change_variable = { name = ac_seal_dice_left add = -1 }
	}
	remove_variable = ac_seal_dice_left
}
ac_seal_roll_effect = { ac_seal_dice_effect = { OUT = ac_seal_successes DICE = ac_seal_dice } }
ac_seal_resist_roll_effect = { ac_seal_dice_effect = { OUT = ac_seal_resist DICE = ac_seal_resist_dice_$SKILL$ } }
ac_seal_power_clash_effect = { ac_seal_dice_effect = { OUT = ac_seal_resist DICE = ac_seal_power_dice } }

# Duel: release a Soulsoak charge (fighter scope).
ac_seal_release_soulsoak_effect = {
	change_variable = { name = ac_soulsoak add = -1 }
	if = { limit = { var:ac_soulsoak <= 0 } remove_variable = ac_soulsoak }
	add_character_flag = ac_duel_soulsoak
}
